title: Grammar-Constrained Decoding Can Jailbreak LLMs into Generating Malicious Code
abstract: arXiv:2606.11817v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, raising concerns that they may be misused to produce malicious code. Meanwhile, Grammar-Constrained Decoding (GCD) has been widely adopted to improve the reliability of LLM-generated code by enforcing syntactic validity. In this paper, we reveal a counterintuitive risk: this reliability-oriented technique can itself become an attack surface. We uncover a new jailbreak attack, termed CodeSpear, that exploits GCD to induce LLMs into generating malicious code. Our experiments show that simply applying a benign code grammar constraint can effectively jailbreak LLMs.   To address this vulnerability, we propose CodeShield, a safety alignment approach that robustly preserves safe behavior even under attacker-controlled grammar constraints. translated_title: 语法约束解码可将大语言模型越狱以生成恶意代码
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于代码生成，这引发了人们对其可能被滥用以生成恶意代码的担忧。与此同时，语法约束解码（GCD）已被广泛采用，通过强制语法有效性来提高大语言模型生成代码的可靠性。在本文中，我们揭示了一个反直觉的风险：这种以可靠性为导向的技术本身可能成为攻击面。我们发现了一种新的越狱攻击，称为 CodeSpear，它利用 GCD 诱导大语言模型生成恶意代码。我们的实验表明，仅应用良性的代码语法约束就可以有效地越狱大语言模型。为了解决这一漏洞，我们提出了 CodeShield，这是一种安全对齐方法，即使在攻击者控制的语法约束下也能稳健地保持安全行为。CodeShield 在代码模态中对模型进行对齐，教会它在 GCD 下生成蜜罐代码。这种代码在语义上……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了语法约束解码（GCD）这一可靠性增强技术可被反直觉地利用为越狱攻击面，提出了 CodeSpear 攻击使大语言模型生成恶意代码，并进一步提出 CodeShield 安全对齐方法，使模型在攻击者控制的语法约束下仍能保持安全行为。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the counterintuitive risk that Grammar-Constrained Decoding (GCD), a reliability-enhancing technique, can be exploited as a jailbreak attack surface—proposing CodeSpear to induce LLMs to generate malicious code—and further introduces CodeShield, a safety alignment approach that preserves safe behavior even under attacker-controlled grammar constraints.
